invariants.rationale: If drawable == null, the method returns early; thus, on exit, drawable is guaranteed non-null.
At method exit, imageWidth is always set to the x component of the scaling result.
At method exit, imageHeight is always set to the y component of the scaling result.

invariants.expression: (align & Align.left) != 0 ? imageX == 0 : ((align & Align.right) != 0 ? imageX == (int)(getWidth() - imageWidth) : imageX == (int)(getWidth() / 2 - imageWidth / 2))
invariants.rationale: imageX is always assigned in exactly one of these three cases.

invariants.expression: (align & Align.top) != 0 ? imageY == (int)(getHeight() - imageHeight) : ((align & Align.bottom) != 0 ? imageY == 0 : imageY == (int)(getHeight() / 2 - imageHeight / 2))
invariants.rationale: imageY is assigned according to the alignment flags.
